text:
lena: heads-up: on small phones the table "swipe to reveal" gesture is conflicting with system back gesture and bottom nav. seen on iPhone 12 mini and some androids.
omar: ugh yes. users trying to swipe row left to Reveal Actions end up triggering the nav.
ria: repro: close left nav, pinch to zoom off, try row-swipe from 8px inward from left edge -> OS back. we should avoid edge-to-edge swipe targets.
tyler: option: move swipe zone inside (start at 24px from left) or offer persistent overflow (...) affordance instead of swipe on narrow screens.
sam: pragmatic CSS: disable row swipe at <=420px and show a 3-dot overflow at end of row. snippet:
```css
@media (max-width:420px){
  .row-swipe { pointer-events: none; }
  .overflow-icon { display:inline-flex; }
}
```
lena: i prefer keeping one accessible gesture — maybe long-press reveals actions instead of swipe. that avoids edge gestures and is discoverable with a tooltip.
omar: long-press is ok but needs haptic hint on mobile and clear affordance for users who don't know it. also it's not keyboard friendly.
ria: accessibility: always include an aria-label on the overflow button and ensure actions are reachable via keyboard navigation. for long-press we need an alternative trigger (keyboard focus + space/enter)
tyler: copy note: change overflow label from "More" to "Row actions" at small sizes so screen readers announce intent. short visual text can stay as icon.
sam: also watch safe-area insets on iOS (home indicator) — action sheet must respect env(safe-area-inset-bottom) or close btn might be unreachable.
lena: good catch. on foldables we also saw layout break where columns snap to multiple lines -> action icons wrap under text making rows super tall. propose: at <360px collapse non-essential columns into a secondary details panel.
omar: agree. breakpoints: >=1024 full table, 768-1023 medium, 420-767 reduced, <420 minimal. within minimal: hide "region" and "created" columns, move them to details panel.
ria: visual tweak: when we collapse columns, add a subtle chevron to expand row (48px hit area) so the affordance is obvious.
tyler: small perf note: don't render expanded details server-side on initial list load at <420 to avoid extra DOM. lazy-mount when user taps expand.
sam: added a preview build with these changes: https://staging.redwood/preview/gesture-fix-1777 (disabled row-swipe under 420, added overflow icon and details panel).
design-bot: deploy preview ready — please run quick mobile QA and add notes to the PR template.
lena: action items: sam toggle swipe off at <=420 + overflow icon, tyler implement details panel + lazy mount, ria a11y review for aria-labels and keyboard triggers. can we do a 5-minute test after lunch?
omar: i'll run the 1-thumb reachability check on a Pixel 4a and iPhone 12 mini.
lena: thanks. aim to merge this week so it lands in next patch release. :rocket:
